Name: Volcano

Params.Name: NoiseAlgorithm
Params.Label: Noise Algorithm
Params.Description: Chooses the noise that distorts the volcano slope, summit, and terrain outside the cone.

Params.Name: NoiseScale
Params.Label: Noise Scale
Params.Description: Sets the size of volcanic slope variation, summit breakup, and outside terrain noise.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values create more closely spaced volcano features.

Params.Name: NoiseSeed
Params.Label: Noise Seed
Params.Description: Rearranges volcano slope and outside-terrain variation without moving the volcano center.
Params.Tooltip: Use a new seed for a different volcanic surface pattern.

Params.Name: NoiseWarp
Params.Label: Noise Warp
Params.Description: Bends volcanic slope and surrounding-terrain noise for less regular contours.
Params.Tooltip: Increase it for more organic volcanic forms.

Params.Name: NoiseJitter
Params.Label: Noise Jitter
Params.Description: Offsets cellular feature points in volcanic slope and outside-terrain detail.
Params.Tooltip: Only affects Gabor, Voronoi, and Worley; it changes local volcano variation placement.

Sections.Name: Shape
Sections.Label: Shape
Sections.Description: Primary form, amplitude, and profile controls.

Params.Name: Strength
Params.Description: Scales the overall height amplitude of the generated shape.
Params.Tooltip: Adjust the overall strength of this base shape.

Params.Name: Height
Params.Description: Controls the vertical height of the generated feature.

Params.Name: Radius
Params.Description: Controls the size of the primary radial feature.
Params.Tooltip: Increase radius to affect a larger area.

Params.Name: MountainFalloff
Params.Label: Mountain Falloff
Params.Description: Controls the falloff from the volcano's central mountain.
Params.Tooltip: Increase it to spread the mountain transition over a larger area.

Params.Name: CraterRadius
Params.Label: Crater Radius
Params.Description: Controls the radius of the volcanic crater.
Params.Tooltip: Increase crater radius for a wider opening.

Params.Name: CraterDepth
Params.Label: Crater Depth
Params.Description: Controls the depth of the volcanic crater.
Params.Tooltip: Increase crater depth for a stronger central depression.

Sections.Name: Detail
Sections.Label: Detail
Sections.Description: Secondary detail, distortion, and deterministic variation.

Params.Name: Distortion
Params.Description: Controls the amount of procedural warping applied to the shape.
Params.Tooltip: Increase distortion for a less regular silhouette.

Params.Name: DistortionScale
Params.Label: Distortion Scale
Params.Description: Controls the size of the distortion pattern.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values generally create finer distortion.

Params.Name: Seed
Params.Description: Selects the deterministic random pattern used by the generator.
Params.Tooltip: Change the seed to create a different reproducible layout.

Params.Name: OutsideNoise
Params.Label: Outside Noise
Params.Description: Controls noise applied outside the primary feature.
Params.Tooltip: Increase this value to add more surrounding terrain variation.

Params.Name: OutsideNoiseScale
Params.Label: Outside Noise Scale
Params.Description: Controls the scale of noise applied outside the primary feature.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values generally create finer outside variation.

Params.Name: Offset
Params.Description: Translates the sampling coordinates without changing the shape's scale.
Params.Tooltip: Use the offset to move through the procedural field.

Description: Generates a volcano-style procedural base shape with controls for its main form and variation.
